release_helper.cross_fde_jump: 0x5d350c0 jumps to 0x5d35070 (a different FDE, 0x5d35070..0x5d350bc) on the destroy path (jmp at 0x5d35140).
release_helper.rule: Read the 8-byte refcount pair at +0x08. If it is exactly {use=1, weak=1}, set both counts to 0 and call vtable slot 2 (dispose) then slot 3 (delete). Otherwise decrement the use count; when the old use count was 1, run the destroy dispatch 0x5d35070 (dispose, decrement weak, delete when the old weak count was 1). The single-threaded flag at 0x64ed290 selects plain vs lock-prefixed increments; the counts are the same either way.

build_gates: The lookup runs first: a missing role-9 entry throws even when the +0x58 shared_ptr is null.
factory+0x58 shared_ptr must be non-null (cmpq $0x0,0x58(%rbx); je return).
The role-9 value must be 0 (mov 0x24(%rax),%eax; test; je build). Nonzero skips the build.

lookup.role_link: The same enumerator value 9 appears as the template argument of the constructed impl type (CacheReservationManagerImpl<CacheEntryRole::9>); the enumerator name for 9 is not recovered from the binary.
lookup.rule: lower_bound(9): walk down comparing node key +0x20 with 8 (key > 8 goes left, recording the candidate; else goes right); the landed node must have key <= 9, i.e. exactly 9, else std::out_of_range("map::at") is thrown (literal at 0x4408a7; the empty-map case throws too, since the root is null).

role_map.population: Deep structural copy of the source tree rooted at source+0x90 via 0x60d7fb0 (_M_copy): same entries, same colors, same shape, independent nodes. The destination header is then wired: root at +0xb0, leftmost at +0xb8 (walk down +0x10), rightmost at +0xc0 (walk down +0x18), count at +0xc8 from source+0xa8. CORRECTION to PR #3254: the tree is NOT populated by the 0x6099ce0 push-back call (PR #3257 already corrected that the push-back appends to the record vector at +0x08, not the tree); the population mechanism is the _M_copy pinned here.
